visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a deaf perspective camera pan through a modern home office featuring dual monitors and a gaming tower with RGB lighting, then moves into a grey-tiled bathroom. (2) A young woman with long black hair, Sandy, is found lying on a carpeted floor with her head inside a pet carrier, cuddling and sniffing her tan spaniel dog, Kaka. (3) Rapid jump cuts show Sandy intensely sniffing the dog's fur on a beige sofa, accompanied by white and yellow comic-style text overlays. She wears a white crop top with green trim. (4) Sandy is later seen lying on the floor covered in a striped blanket, looking tired and checking a smartphone resting on the carpet. (5) A man's hand enters the frame holding a smartphone showing a mobile game, prompting a sudden shift in Sandy's expression to excitement as she sits up in a blue athletic jersey. (6) A high-energy montage concludes the video, showing gameplay from 'Tree of Savior M' alongside Sandy dancing, singing, and playing the game while her dog rests nearby.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a male voice calling out 'San~' twice in a friendly, searching tone. The BGM is a light, mid-tempo acoustic-pop track. Ambient room tone is quiet and clean. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' SFX triggers as the scene shifts. Sandy responds with a high-pitched, muffled voice. The music becomes more energetic with a steady synthetic beat. (3) Rapid-fire impact SFX and pops occur during the jump-cut sequence, with BGM volume swelling to emphasize the comedic sniffing sounds. Sandy's vocal arousal is high. (4) The audio softens as the male speaker uses a low-volume, empathetic tone to ask about Sandy's health. Sandy's speech rate slows, sounding weak and fatigued. (5) A bright 'ding' UI SFX signals a mood shift. Sandy's voice suddenly rises in pitch and intensity. A driving 4/4 electronic drum beat starts, transitioning the BGM into a high-tempo promotional jingle. (6) Sandy's voice becomes melodic as she sings a catchy, professional jingle. Frequent digital UI and 'sparkle' SFX are layered over the mix to match the game footage, concluding with a final high-energy musical stinger.
